title: Oven Roasted Spanish Chicken Paella
description: A kid-friendly Spanish dish featuring chicken, vegetables, and digestive biscuits, all cooked to perfection in a tandoor clay pot. This low-fat friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together yuzu juice, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the yuzu mixture.
Heat the olive oil in the tandoor clay pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and bell pepper to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the crushed digestive biscuits to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the diced tomato and chicken broth to the pot and stir to combine.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the liquid has been absorbed.
